The '''F'Dann system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located near the [[Dulfilvian system|Dufilvian system]]. It contained at least nine inhabited [[Planet/Legends|worlds]],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> including [[F'Dann IX]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] had problems with the [[Crimson Nova]] pirates in this system.<ref name="TTaBSb" />
